git stash && python3 -c "
from more_itertools import seekable
it = seekable((str(n) for n in range(20)))
print(f'next: {next(it)}, {next(it)}, {next(it)}')
print(f'cache={it._cache}, _index={it._index}')
# Manually do what relative_seek(1) would do: seek to position 4
it.seek(4)
print(f'After seek(4): cache={it._cache}, _index={it._index}')
print(f'next: {next(it)}')
print(f'After next: cache={it._cache}, _index={it._index}')
# Now do relative_seek(-2): seek to position 3 (5-2=3)
it.seek(3)
print(f'After seek(3): cache={it._cache}, _index={it._index}')
print(f'next: {next(it)}')
" 2>&1
